world.title: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'

world.title: How Spain's migrant crisis created a political storm - whipped up by social media

world.title: Five dead, 41 missing, after Indonesia ferry catches fire
world.description: The vessel with at least 250 people on board caught fire off Madura island.

world.title: Young guns for hire - the teenage hitmen recruited to kill across Europe
world.description: The Foxtrot Network is thought to be responsible for about 35 murders in Europe, and uses violence-as-a-service tactics.

world.title: A bruising 24 hours - what next for Fifa and under-pressure Infantino?

world.title: Tourist plane crashes in Peru, killing 13
world.description: The small plane was flying over the Nazca Lines ​archaeological site when it crashed, according to local reports.

world.title: Italy putting nearly all major cities on highest heat alert

world.title: The Sopranos star Vincent Pastore dies aged 80

world.title: Why Uganda seems to be winning the battle against Ebola as virus spreads in DR Congo
world.description: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient from hospital roughly two weeks ago.

world.title: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say

world.title: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
world.description: Settler violence against Palestinians is on the rise in the West Bank, as settlements and outposts expand.

world.title: Current Ebola outbreak worst ever in DR Congo, WHO says
world.description: The current strain has so far killed 1,587 people, and there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment.

world.title: How Australia combines modern tech and Indigenous knowledge to fight wildfires

US.title: We asked a first grader to interview his hero: A bird scientist
US.description: NPR asked an aspiring scientist in Philadelphia to interview an adult who is living his dream about his career in conservation science.

US.title: What Cyclospora does inside the gut and how it gets there

US.title: Idaho fast food restaurant shooting leaves 3 dead, city spokesman says
US.description: Police who responded to the shooting found the body of the suspected gunman in an area near the restaurant.

US.title: Trump says he's cancelling Iran strikes, deal pending
US.description: Trump said Iran and other Middle Eastern countries had asked the U.S. "to hold off any attack" on Iran because "the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to."

US.title: Overnight Russian barrage kills nine in Kyiv, as air defense struggle with U.S. continues
US.description: Ballistic missiles tore into five districts of the Ukrainian capital before dawn Saturday. President Trump is now walking back a promised boost to Ukraine's missile defense systems.
